Everplans review: digital legacy verdict

Verdict: A well-structured digital vault for life admin and end-of-life plans that you can securely share with people you trust. Best for: Organised planners who want a guided inventory of accounts, wishes and documents.

Key facts

  • Category: Estate & document tools
  • Pricing: Free base app; Everplans Premium is paid. Check current pricing.
  • Best for: Organised planners who want a guided inventory of accounts, wishes and documents.
  • Guided templates for wishes, accounts and documents
  • Securely share selected items with people you trust

Official site / docs ↗

What are the pros and cons of Everplans?

Pros

  • Guided templates for wishes, accounts and documents
  • Securely share selected items with people you trust
  • Reminders and alerts for important dates; enterprise version for advisors and firms

Cons

  • Mostly US-oriented content
  • Doesn't create legal documents itself

What are similar tools?

Estate & document tools

Trust & Will

Popular online tool for US wills and trusts with guided questions. Not built for Australian or most non-US jurisdictions.

Estate & document tools

GoodTrust

An all-in-one US estate planning platform: will, trust and directives (valid in all 50 states) plus a Digital Vault for your digital life.

Estate & document tools

Prisidio

A family 'life readiness' vault with a Co-Owner and a Keyholder who can get the vault after a verified death, with identity checks via CLEAR.
